{{Quote|Ulic may no longer have been able to touch the Force, but he understood it more than any of us. He had the heart of a Jedi.|[[Vima Sunrider]], recorded on the [[Great Holocron/Legends|Great Holocron]]|<ref name="jvs">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
'''Ulic Qel-Droma''' was, during different parts of his life, a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]], and a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Ulic and his brother [[Cay Qel-Droma|Cay]] were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lien-Tsai Qel-Droma]], but [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] alongside the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Tott Doneeta]] under Master [[Arca Jeth]] on [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]]. In [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], Ulic was sent with Cay and Doneeta to resolve the [[Time/Legends|centuries]]-long [[Beast Wars]] of the planet [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Although they initially sided with the [[Iziz ruling family|monarchy]] of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], Qel-Droma and his fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] eventually allied with the [[Beast Riders]] of Onderon after they learned that the Royal Family worshiped the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] under the leadership of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]]. A [[Battle of Iziz|great battle]] subsequently broke out between the Queen's forces and those of the Beast Riders, and ended when Ulic's Master Jeth arrived to assist in the defeat of Amanoa, which brought temporary peace to Onderon.

Amanoa's [[Marriage/Legends|husband]], [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]], emerged from hiding in [[3998 BBY]] to disrupt Onderon's peace by waging [[Freedon Nadd Uprising|war in the name]] of the ancient Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Freedon Nadd]]. Qel-Droma and the Jedi once again fought to defend Onderon, but when Master Jeth was captured by Ommin and Freedon Nadd's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]], Qel-Droma requested aid from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Qel-Droma's help arrived in the form of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and a team of five additional Jedi Knights, led by novice Jedi [[Nomi Sunrider]]&mdash;with whom Qel-Droma would later fall in love. Bolstered by the strength of the [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] and Sunrider's innate talent with Jedi [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]], Qel-Droma and his comrades rescued Jeth, [[Second Battle of Onderon|defeated]] King Ommin and his [[Naddist army|army]], and banished Freedon Nadd's ghost from the planet forever. When the Jedi learned of a [[Political uprising of the Empress Teta system|political uprising]] in the [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] system by the newly formed [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] [[Sith cult/Legends|cult]], Qel-Droma acted as a liaison for the Order and joined the Republic for an [[Battle of Koros Major|assault]] in Tetan [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. However, Qel-Droma was overcome by the Krath's [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] and suffered near-fatal wounds as the Republic was forced into retreat by the Sith usurpers.

The Jedi had become increasingly concerned with the threat posed to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the Krath, and [[Conclave at Deneba|gathered en masse]] on the planet [[Deneba/Legends|Deneba]] to discuss a course of action. It was there that Qel-Droma outlined a controversial plan to [[Mission to Empress Teta|infiltrate]] the dark side cult and destroy them from within, a proposal that was rejected by nearly all those present. The Krath soon [[Battle of Deneba|ambushed]] the [[Jedi Convocation|convocation]] with a bombardment of [[Krath war droid/Legends|war droids]]. Qel-Droma fought alongside his fellow Jedi, but was devastated when Jeth was unexpectedly [[Death/Legends|killed]]. He then swore to avenge his Master through infiltration of the Krath, against the pleas of his peers. Qel-Droma traveled to Empress Teta and joined them, initially pretending to be a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]]. Soon, however, he was injected with a rage-inducing [[Sith poison|poison]] by Krath warlord [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]] and began over time to fall to the dark side himself. The Jedi soon came to retrieve him and witnessed the [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Satal Keto)|death]] of Satal Keto at Qel-Droma's hands, before the enraged Dark Jedi lashed out at his friends and refused their rescue attempt. Later, when the Jedi [[Battle of Empress Teta|tried and failed]] to extract Qel-Droma&mdash;now the Krath leader, having taken Keto's cousin [[Aleema Keto]] as his lover&mdash;another of Freedon Nadd's students, [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], arrived to eliminate the Krath. Qel-Droma [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Exar Kun)|engaged]] him in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], but the contest was interrupted by the spirit of a [[Marka Ragnos|long-deceased Sith]], who proclaimed Qel-Droma and Kun to be [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]]. [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Together]], they resolved to [[Great Sith War/Legends|wage war]] on the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

The new Sith Lord Qel-Droma began to consolidate his own power, first with his [[Duel on Kuar|subjugation]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior clans and his hijacking of Republic military resources. Qel-Droma eventually led an [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Sith War)|attack]] on the galactic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he was betrayed and abandoned by Aleema Keto and then captured by Jedi Knights under the leadership of Master [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]]. Scheduled to stand [[Trial of Ulic Qel-Droma|trial]] as a war criminal before the Galactic Senate, Qel-Droma was ultimately [[Duel in the Senate|rescued]] by Kun and [[Mandalore the Indomitable]], with whom Qel-Droma resumed his campaign of terror against the Republic. After [[Battle of Kemplex Nine|eliminating]] the treacherous Aleema Keto, Qel-Droma next joined Kun in an [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|assault]] on the Jedi fortress-world of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], where he slew his brother Cay in the presence of his former comrades. The act of fratricide infuriated the Jedi, and Nomi Sunrider exercised her power to [[Sever Force/Legends|sever]] Qel-Droma's connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Utterly defeated and mortified by his own actions, Qel-Droma renounced his allegiance to the [[Brotherhood of the Sith|Sith]]. He then led the Jedi to Kun's [[Great Temple/Legends|stronghold]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], where the combined forces of the Jedi and the Republic Navy [[Wall of light|defeated]] the fugitive Dark Lord in a [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Great Sith War)|final battle]]. After the war, a broken Qel-Droma [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] himself to [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]], and hoped to live out his [[Standard day/Legends|days]] in solitude. However, he was found by an aspiring Jedi&mdash;Nomi Sunrider's daughter [[Vima Sunrider|Vima]], whom he agreed to train as a Jedi. After he found success and a measure of inner peace through his tutelage of Sunrider, Qel-Droma was soon killed, shot by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] named [[Hoggon]] who wanted to become a famous hero.

==Biography==
===Early life and Jedi training===
{{Quote|Well done! But keep your thoughts with the Force, Ulic!|Arca Jeth, during Ulic Qel-Droma's lightsaber training|<ref name="beastwars1">[[Tales of the Jedi 1|''Tales of the Jedi'' 1]]</ref>}}
[[File:LightsaberTrainingDroid.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma practicing his lightsaber skills with a training droid on Arkania]]
Ulic Qel-Droma was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], slightly more than four thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="totjcompanion">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> to the famed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lien-Tsai Qel-Droma]].<ref name="jatm">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> Qel-Droma had a younger brother named [[Cay Qel-Droma|Cay]] with whom he shared a deep bond, and both were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] with great potential.<ref name="totjcompanion" /> They additionally had a cousin named [[Duron Qel-Droma|Duron]], who was also [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive and would eventually become a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="shadows">{{Tales|23|Shadows and Light}}</ref> Although their [[Parent/Legends|mother]] taught the Qel-Droma brothers well in many subjects, she did not [[Jedi training/Legends|instruct]] them in the ways of the Force, as she believed that she could not keep the necessary distance between student and Master with her children. As she did not want to begin their training too early, Lien-Tsai Qel-Droma waited until she believed Ulic and Cay had reached the proper age to send them to learn under the skilled [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Arca Jeth]]. In the meantime, Qel-Droma became well known by the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Noble/Legends|nobility]], who largely disapproved of whatever he did and looked upon him with disdain. Qel-Droma felt the need to prove his worth, and threw himself entirely into his studies and extracurricular activities. Qel-Droma eventually drew the respect of his superiors as he turned his attention from challenge to challenge. However, Qel-Droma neglected his study of the Force in favor of his other pursuits, and only focused on it when all his other options were exhausted. Qel-Droma immediately discovered his natural talent with the Force when he did so, and he gained a new confidence in himself.<ref name="totjcompanion" />

Qel-Droma poured himself into his study of the Force and the Jedi way, so much so that his mother worried that he had missed the message of what the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] stood for and would have trouble if he continued that way. However, Qel-Droma dismissed her fears by quoting from the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]]. Soon afterward, his mother sent both Ulic and Cay to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]] to learn under Arca Jeth at his [[Arca Jeth's praxeum|praxeum]]. The Qel-Droma brothers met a fellow [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Tott Doneeta]], with whom they quickly became friends.<ref name="totjcompanion" /> Partly through the practice of his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] skills on [[combat-trainer]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]&mdash;which he considered to be old, slow, and unchallenging<ref name="beastwars1" />&mdash;Qel-Droma quickly mastered the techniques taught to him by Master Jeth. Over the course of his training, however, Qel-Droma drew concern from Jeth due to his relentless efforts and often-reckless attempts to prove himself. Qel-Droma was instructed not to act before thinking, and the apprentice vowed to rein in his natural urgings and make sure he was always in control.<ref name="totjcompanion" /> During his tutelage under Jeth, Qel-Droma also constructed his own lightsaber.<ref name="dssourcebook">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref>

===First encounters===
====Trouble on Onderon====
{{Quote|The Onderonians have asked for help in ending their centuries-long state of war. They will want you to fight&hellip; but remember, Ulic, the Jedi bring ''peace''&hellip; use your weapons as a last resort.''"<br />"''We will do as you ask, Master. We only request that you keep us in your thoughts.''"<br />"''In the power of the Force, I will be with you, Ulic. But this is to be a ''test'' of your Knighthood&hellip; ''you'' and your companions must make your ''own'' way through the difficulties you encounter. ''May the Force be with you''.|Arca Jeth and Ulic Qel-Droma, before the latter's mission to Onderon|<ref name="beastwars1" />}}
In [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], after a particularly eventful lightsaber training session which ended in a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] bolt to the midsection, Qel-Droma and his two fellow apprentices gathered before Master Jeth.<ref name="beastwars1" /> With the use of a [[Mind trick/Legends#Force illusion|Force illusion]],<ref name="audio">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref> the Arkanian proceeded to tell them the story of the planet [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], recently discovered by [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Scout/Legends|explorers]], which was embroiled in a [[Beast Wars|war]] between the government of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] and banished criminals known as the [[Beast Riders]]. At the conclusion of his tale, Jeth informed his three apprentices that he had accepted the post of [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Jedi Watchman]] in the [[Japrael system/Legends|Onderon system]]. Stunned, Qel-Droma was worried that Jeth was leaving them, only to learn that the three Padawans would travel there in the Jedi Master's stead. After years of training, the brothers and Doneeta were finally assigned their first mission. Ulic Qel-Droma was made chargeman and advised that their objective was a peaceful end to the Beast Wars, with raised arms as a last resort.<ref name="beastwars1" />

[[File:Iziz_Royal_Palace.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma, his brother Cay, and Tott Doneeta stand before Queen Amanoa in the Iziz Royal Palace.]]
The Jedi departed Arkania in<ref name="beastwars1" /> Cay's [[Starship/Legends|ship]],<ref name="potj">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> the ''[[Nebulon Ranger]]'', with Ulic Qel-Droma at the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] controls. Upon arrival in the Onderonian [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], the ''Ranger'' was suddenly swarmed by<ref name="beastwars1" /> thirty to forty<ref name="audio" /> [[drexl]]-mounted Beast Riders. Although under heavy [[Laser/Legends|fire]], Qel-Droma successfully flew through the horde without firing a shot, and landed safely at the [[Iziz Royal Palace]]. The Jedi met the Onderonian [[Minister of State]], [[Novar (Human)|Novar]], whose men seized Doneeta in accordance with Iziz's prohibition of [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] visitors to the Royal Citadel. After the Qel-Droma brothers ignited their lightsabers, however, Novar unhanded Doneeta and led them to meet [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]] and the young [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Galia]]. Amanoa, a Force-sensitive herself, was hesitant to work with such young Jedi, as she had expected the venerable Arca Jeth to come to Onderon&mdash;Qel-Droma quickly dismissed her concerns, promising that the whole of the Jedi Order would be at her service if she embraced the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="beastwars1" />

The Royal Palace was soon [[Raid on the Iziz Royal Palace|attacked]] by a Beast Rider strike force, the same group that had attacked the ''Nebulon Ranger'' earlier. The Jedi quickly moved to defend the palace as Amanoa and Galia fled deeper into the building. Qel-Droma defeated several Beast Riders during the battle, and also slew several of their mighty drexl war mounts. Despite the Jedi's best efforts, two [[Beast Warrior Commando]]s slipped past them and made their way toward the Queen and Princess's hiding place. Cay and Doneeta broke off to chase the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], while Qel-Droma fended off the remaining attackers, who suddenly retreated without warning. Qel-Droma went to the royal quarters to check on his brother and Doneeta, only to find that the Beast Rider commandos had kidnapped Princess Galia. Against his partners' advice, Qel-Droma promised to find the Queen's daughter, and the three left Iziz in the ''Nebulon Ranger''.<ref name="beastwars1" /> During their search above the Onderonian wilderness, the Jedi caught sight of a [[Kira Fortress|fortress]] carved into a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]], with several Beast Riders around it.<ref name="audio" /> However, almost immediately afterward, the ''Nebulon Ranger'' was hit by a Beast Rider [[seeker-torpedo]] and crashed deep within the forest.<ref name="beastwars1" />

====Switching sides====
{{Quote|Together we can bring ''peace'' to this chaotic world.|Ulic Qel-Droma, to Oron Kira|<ref name="beastwars2">[[Tales of the Jedi 2|''Tales of the Jedi'' 2]]</ref>}}
Although the ''Nebulon Ranger'' was heavily damaged, the three Jedi emerged relatively unscathed, as the ship's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] cushioned them from most of the impact. While Qel-Droma and his brother surveyed the damage, Doneeta scouted further ahead in the forest. The Twi'lek came across a group of [[boma]] beasts, which he [[Animal bond|tamed]] with the Force. The now-friendly bomas revealed that the Princess had been taken to a nearby stronghold, where she was to [[Binding Ceremony of Oron Kira and Galia|marry]] [[Oron Kira]], son of [[Beast-Lord]] [[Modon Kira]]. Qel-Droma and his companions rode the bomas into the citadel and interrupted the ceremony. Qel-Droma was able to grab hold of Galia, but she surprisingly protested, as she actually wanted to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] Oron Kira. Qel-Droma unhanded the Princess, and soon afterward accepted an invitation from Modon Kira to speak during the wedding banquet. There, Oron Kira and Galia revealed to Qel-Droma that the [[Iziz ruling family|Onderon Royal Family]] were [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Darksider|users]], [[Sith cult]]ists who worshiped the [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Freedon Nadd]], who had subjugated the planet centuries before. Qel-Droma was shocked, as he had previously thought Onderon too primitive a world to have been touched by the dark side. Modon Kira then came forward with a proposition&mdash;he had gathered all the [[Beast Rider army|armies]] of the Beast Riders together for one final [[Battle of Iziz|assault]] and wanted Qel-Droma and the Jedi to battle the dark side with them. Qel-Droma responded with a different idea&mdash;he, the other Jedi, and the newlywed Kira and Galia would go to Iziz first and try to bring a peaceful end to the Beast Wars. If they failed, then there would be war.<ref name="beastwars2" />

[[File:UlicSavingCay.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma saving his injured brother Cay during the battle in the Iziz Royal Palace]]
Modon Kira accepted his proposal, and the group left less than a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] later after Cay repaired the ''Nebulon Ranger''. Accompanied by a Beast Rider escort, the ''Nebulon Ranger'' was initially fired upon by the [[Iziz defense tower|Iziz defense guns]]. Although a last-[[Standard second|second]] plea by Cay got them admission to the Royal Palace, Queen Amanoa quickly rebuffed Qel-Droma's offers of peace and [[Waves of darkness|called]] the power of the dark side down upon the would-be peacebringers. Qel-Droma immediately felt its effects, as his thoughts became clouded and confused and he was filled with fear.<ref name="beastwars2" /> Under heavy fire from the [[Royal Protector|Palace security]] forces&mdash;who were also [[Dark side adept/Legends|adept]] in the dark side<ref name="audio" />&mdash;Qel-Droma followed Galia to a secure hiding place<ref name="beastwars2" /> in her [[Ommin/Legends|father's]] old [[Ommin's laboratory|workshop]].<ref name="audio" /> There, Qel-Droma told Oron Kira to signal his father to send in the Beast Rider [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] and begin the battle outright. Qel-Droma soon realized that he had left his brother Cay behind in the throne room and went to retrieve him, and found his brother alive but with a severed [[Limb/Legends|arm]].<ref name="beastwars2" /> After treating Cay's wounds,<ref name="audio" /> Ulic brought him to their hiding place, where he watched as Cay removed the arm of a nearby droid to use as a [[Cybernetics/Legends|replacement]] for the one cut off during the battle.<ref name="beastwars2" />

Once Cay was done, the Qel-Droma brothers made their way out of the Palace to the city ramparts, where Doneeta, Galia, and Oron Kira were watching the battle. There, Qel-Droma received an update on the conflict's progress from Doneeta, who informed him that the city had fallen to the Beast Riders after a sudden change in the battle's momentum. Suddenly, Qel-Droma spotted Master Jeth's ship, the ''[[SunGem]]'', in the planet's atmosphere. Jeth landed on the ramparts and voiced his disappointment, especially that Qel-Droma had failed the test he had been given. Jeth revealed that he had won the battle for the Beast Riders with the exotic [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] known as [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] and told Qel-Droma that he should have sensed the work of the dark side the [[Standard minute/Legends|minute]] that he had arrived on Onderon. After their conversation, Jeth led the group down into the [[tomb of Freedon Nadd]], below the planet's surface, where Queen Amanoa had sequestered herself. There, Qel-Droma watched as Amanoa's dark power fled her, and she died. Soon afterward, Qel-Droma attended the ceremony where Oron Kira and Galia consecrated their marriage under the laws of the Republic, merged the warring tribes of Onderon into one people, became the new [[King/Legends|King]] and Queen of Onderon, and finally ended the Beast Wars.<ref name="beastwars2" />

===The Naddist rebellion===
====Attack of the cultists====
{{Quote|If the dark side could take Master Arca, then it's ''too strong'' for us. We're going to need ''more Jedi Knights''&mdash;and the ''forces of the Republic!''|Ulic Qel-Droma, after the first battle of the Freedon Nadd Uprising|<ref name="uprising1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 1]]</ref>}}
Although the Beast Wars were over, peace still did not come easily to Onderon&mdash;within [[3998 BBY|two years]], the planet was once again at war. [[Naddist]] cult members from the same organization that claimed the world's monarchy were in open [[Freedon Nadd Uprising|rebellion]] against the new monarchy. In response, Qel-Droma and his fellow Jedi Watchmen were tasked with defending Onderon. By then, Qel-Droma had moved past his training period, and had assumed the title of Jedi Knight. Master Jeth ordered that the stone [[Freedon Nadd's sarcophagus|sarcophagi]] containing the remains of Freedon Nadd and Amanoa be removed from Onderon, with the hopes that it would reduce the dark side pall still hanging over Iziz. This took on the form of a grand [[Funeral of Amanoa|funeral procession]] through the Iziz city streets, led by Galia and Oron Kira. Qel-Droma, his brother, and Jeth marched directly behind them, and met with the monarchs, Tott Doneeta, and newly arrived [[Vultan]] Jedi [[Oss Wilum]] after the ceremony was concluded. To the Jedi group's surprise, as the [[Sith sarcophagus|sarcophagi]] were being loaded onto their [[Transport/Legends|transport]], a colossal [[groundborer]] machine suddenly emerged through the planet's surface, containing hundreds of dissident members of the [[Royal Armed Forces]] now on the Naddist side. Led by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Warb Null]], the Naddist force attacked. While most of the Jedi immediately [[Funeral of Amanoa|battled]] back, Qel-Droma initially stayed behind to tend to Jeth, who had been struck and injured by a dark side assault. Qel-Droma soon joined the fight himself and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|clashed lightsabers]] with Null, but the Naddists successfully gained control of the sarcophagi, their real target. Once they had achieved their goal, the darksiders immediately fled the battlefield,<ref name="uprising1" /> while Qel-Droma was nearly dragged down with them as the groundborer retreated underground.<ref name="audio" />

[[File:Warbnulldeath.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma strikes down Warb Null.]]
After the skirmish, Qel-Droma returned to tend to the fallen Jeth, who was sure that something terrible was at work. It was then that the newly crowned Queen Galia spoke up and informed Qel-Droma and Jeth that her father, King Ommin, a dark side master himself, was still alive in a secret [[Ommin's subterranean fortress|subterranean facility]] and could help them explain the dark side pall over the city. Qel-Droma, Jeth, and Galia immediately set out to meet with Ommin, who had been confined to the facility after he was stricken with a supposed wasting disease that had softened his [[Bone/Legends|bones]] and required a metal [[Ommin's mechanical exoskeleton|apparatus]] to keep him alive.<ref name="uprising1" /> Their journey led them through pitch-[[Color/Legends|black]] tunnels, which forced Qel-Droma to use the Force to [[Force sight|see]] where his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] could not.<ref name="audio" /> Qel-Droma's group arrived at the subterranean fortress and met with the infirm Ommin, who spoke cryptic words about the continuing presence of Freedon Nadd in Iziz. Suddenly, the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of Nadd took shape and revealed himself to the Jedi. Jeth realized that Ommin had practiced [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] that he had learned from Nadd's spirit for years, the cause of the dark side that still continued to plague the city.<ref name="uprising1" />

Ommin then rose, still attached to his armature, and smothered Jeth in dark side energy before Qel-Droma had a chance to help the Arkanian. At the same [[Time/Legends|time]], Warb Null and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of Naddist warriors entered the room, as Qel-Droma ignited his lightsaber and prepared to defend the Queen. As Qel-Droma battled both Null and the Naddist [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], he witnessed the incapacitated Jeth being carried off by Ommin. Although Null's dark power sapped some of Qel-Droma's strength, the Jedi Knight was still able to kill him and defeat the cultists. Qel-Droma suffered from a form of [[vertigo]] after his trying battle, but he still was able to escape the fortress with the Queen. However, when Qel-Droma and Galia emerged from the underground facility, they found that the Iziz Royal Palace had fallen to the Naddists, and encountered Oron Kira, Cay, and Oss Wilum among the rubble. Needing to regroup, they retreated to the Kira Fortress beyond the city's walls, while Qel-Droma resolved to call other Jedi to aid them in the coming fight to retake Iziz.<ref name="uprising1" />

====Battle with the dark side====
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Ulic''&mdash;what's the matter with you guys&mdash;? Why weren't you ''fightin''?''"<br />"''The ''dark side''&hellip; it's eating at our life force&hellip; ''Sith magic'' is at work&mdash;but for some reason I'm feeling a whole lot ''stronger'' now that my ''fellow Jedi'' are here!|Dace Diath and Ulic Qel-Droma, during the climactic battle of the Freedon Nadd Uprising|<ref name="uprising2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 2]]</ref>}}
Free from the Iziz war zone, Qel-Droma placed a call for help which was received by Galactic Republic [[Minister of Defense (Republic)|Minister of Defense]] [[Netus]]. Military aid was granted to Onderon, in the form of a massive force of [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|Republic rocket-jumpers]] that descended from the atmosphere and led the [[Second Battle of Onderon|battle]] to take back Iziz. The rocket-jumpers arrived at a fortuitous time for Qel-Droma and his allies, as they were under siege in the Kira Fortress. As the dark side ate away at his life force, Qel-Droma and the other Jedi were unable to fight&mdash;however, the Republic forces were able to track Qel-Droma's radio beacon to the forest stronghold. Led by Knight [[Nomi Sunrider]], the relief forces cut a swath through the Naddist ranks and blew the Kira Fortress gates open. Suddenly invigorated by Sunrider's use of battle meditation, Qel-Droma and the other trapped Jedi emerged raring to fight, and the combined forces went on to win the battle. As he surveyed the battlefield after the clash, Qel-Droma came across a prone Sunrider, who had been felled by a mental Force attack. Sunrider awoke from her stupor when Qel-Droma arrived, and she described to him a vision of an emaciated man on a metal armature that she saw during the attack, which Qel-Droma recognized as King Ommin. In the meantime, preparations began for a final assault to retake Iziz and end the Freedon Nadd Uprising. Qel-Droma personally gave words of encouragement to the still-dazed Sunrider, and told her that all the Jedi had to combine to strike back at the dark side and save the kidnapped Master Jeth.<ref name="uprising2" />

[[File:DefeatedOmmin.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma interrogates the defeated King Ommin.]]
Once they were ready, Qel-Droma and seven other Jedi&mdash;Cay, Wilum, Doneeta, Sunrider, [[Dace Diath]], [[Nazzar/Legends|Nazzar]] Prince [[Qrrrl Toq]], and [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Shoaneb Culu]], the latter three also part of the Republic strike team&mdash;joined the battle for Iziz. Although they had to take on hundreds of dark side adepts and [[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]], the Jedi force slowly but surely pushed toward Ommin's lair, as they relied on their [[Force sense/Legends|Force sense]] of Jeth's anguish to guide them. In the midst of the conflict, Qel-Droma witnessed his brother Cay's mechanical arm get [[Cho mok/Legends|chopped off]] and tried to help him, although his brother assured him he was fine and continued to press on. After their defeat of their Naddist attackers, Qel-Droma and the Jedi pushed deeper into Ommin's fortress and eventually reached the decrepit former King himself. When Qel-Droma questioned Ommin on the whereabouts of Jeth, the darksider responded with an attack on the Jedi force with the dark side. Qel-Droma was able to fight through the darkness with the help of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]], and he found the strength to cut through Ommin's armature with his lightsaber. Without his [[exoskeleton]] to support his softened bones, Ommin collapsed in convulsions. Still, even as he writhed on the floor, Ommin refused to give any information on Jeth's location. Suddenly, the spirit of Freedon Nadd appeared at Ommin's side and ended the old darksider's life. Freed by Ommin's death, Jeth emerged and claimed victory for the Jedi; indeed, the Naddists had been defeated in Iziz. However, Nadd, as he disappeared from sight, replied that the Jedi had actually lost, a statement which confused Qel-Droma. With the Freedon Nadd Uprising ended, Qel-Droma and Jeth's other apprentices began a campaign to fully clear Onderon of dark side influence. Qel-Droma and the other Jedi on Onderon attended the long-awaited entombment of the recovered bodies of Amanoa and Freedon Nadd on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], and the dark side pall over the planet was finally lifted.<ref name="uprising2" />

===Fall===
====Rise of the Krath====
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''You.'' You will be one of the ''great ones''&mdash;|The spirit of Freedon Nadd foretells Ulic Qel-Droma's destiny|<ref name="DLotS1">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 1]]</ref>}}
After the Freedon Nadd Uprising, Qel-Droma and his Jedi friends stayed on Onderon, finally at peace. During this rather carefree time, Qel-Droma and the other Jedi learned how to fly the Onderonian warbeasts, and he and Nomi Sunrider began to take a liking to one another. However, their happiness did not last, as Arca Jeth soon sent them on another mission. There had been a [[Political uprising of the Empress Teta system|coup]] in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]],<ref name="DLotS1" /> located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> where nobles [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal]] and [[Aleema Keto]] seized control of the [[Star system/Legends|system]] through use of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Magic/Legends|magic]] taught to them by the late King Ommin. Assigned to deal with this problem&mdash;Qel-Droma had been named Watchman of the Empress Teta system&mdash;<ref name="csweulic">{{CSWECite|III|55|Ulic Qel-Droma}}</ref> Qel-Droma and his fellow Jedi were given their objectives. Specifically, Qel-Droma was paired up with Sunrider to fly to the Empress Teta system and directly lead the joint Jedi&ndash;Republic forces as they tried to [[Battle of Koros Major|save]] the Tetan worlds that were still resisting the coup. Qel-Droma was told to wait until Sunrider had completed a lesson in battle meditation with Jeth, so he stayed with his brother and Tott Doneeta as they watched some of the other Jedi depart for the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. As they suspected that Freedon Nadd was at the heart of this uprising, the two Qel-Droma brothers decided to check out the [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] recovered from Ommin's possessions.<ref name="DLotS1" />

[[File:NaddWarnsUlic-TOTJDLOTS1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma is confronted by the spirit of Freedon Nadd.]]
After they made their way into the Jedi outpost nearby, the Qel-Droma brothers commenced their examination of the artifacts, assisted by a droid called [[T-12]]. As Ulic looked around the storeroom, T-12 handed him an unusual [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]]. As Qel-Droma put his hands on the object, the spirit of Freedon Nadd suddenly appeared. Nadd warned Qel-Droma that the Sith would [[Dark Lord prophecy|rise again]] and told him not to interfere with the work of the dark side. When Qel-Droma challenged Nadd on his assertions, the former Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] told the Jedi that he would be one of the "great ones." Qel-Droma was confused by Nadd's prediction, and when he questioned the spirit on what he meant, Nadd did not clarify. With that, the dead Dark Lord disappeared and left Qel-Droma to ponder his words.<ref name="DLotS1" /> After the incident, Qel-Droma and Sunrider traveled to the Empress Teta system to fight the [[Keto family|Ketos]] and their dark side organization, the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]]. By one [[Standard month/Legends|month]] later, they were aboard the Republic [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] ''[[Reliance I]]'', where they worked with Republic [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Orley Vanicus]]. Their goal was to protect the rebels on [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]], the last planet that still battled against the Krath's rule. However, Qel-Droma and the ''Reliance'' arrived in the Koros Major war zone too late to save the rebels from destruction.<ref name="DLotS2">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 2]]</ref>

Finding a Krath presence still at Koros Major, Qel-Droma instructed Vanicus to transmit a cease-fire order to the Ketos. However, they received no response; instead, a massive herd of [[space grazer]]s, an extinct [[Species/Legends|species]] that once preyed on [[Realspace/Legends|space]] traffic, appeared above the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Although Qel-Droma feared that the creatures would destroy the fleet, Sunrider discerned through the Force that the grazers were mere dark side illusions. Undaunted, Qel-Droma [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] the Republic forces to move in and [[Space warfare/Legends|attack]] the [[Krath command station]]. As a counter, a large group of [[CX-133 Chaos fighter|Chaos starfighters]] emerged from the command station and began a run on the fleet. Although Sunrider believed that these were illusory, some of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were actually real and carried out suicide runs into the Republic vessels. One of the Chaos fighters breached the ''Reliance''{{'s}} canopy, and Qel-Droma was hit and injured by a piece of debris. Although the shrapnel missed any of Qel-Droma's vital organs, he was incapacitated as a worried Sunrider tended to his wounds. Vanicus ordered a full retreat from Koros Major; the Krath had won the day.<ref name="DLotS2" />

====The death of a mentor====
{{Quote|I will do this for Master Arca&hellip; for all Jedi Knights&hellip; and for the good of the Republic! Ulic Qel-Droma will ''conquer'' the dark side of the Force!|Ulic Qel-Droma, after the Battle of Deneba|<ref name="DLotS3">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 3|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 3]]</ref>}}
[[File:DenebaUlic.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma during the Conclave on Deneba]]
After the defeat at Koros Major, the Jedi Order realized the threat caused by the existence of the Krath, and called a [[Jedi Convocation]] at the<ref name="DLotS3" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> planet [[Deneba/Legends|Deneba]]. With the Krath's recent declaration of war against the Jedi Knights, the entire Order flocked to [[Mount Meru (Deneba)|Mount Meru]], a natural landmark on Deneba where the Jedi [[Conclave at Deneba|conclave]] was to be held. Despite being heavily bandaged due to the injuries sustained in the battle at Koros Major, Qel-Droma made the trip as well.<ref name="DLotS3" /> While his wounds made it difficult to walk, Qel-Droma repeatedly refused offers of help and climbed up the mountain himself. As he walked with Sunrider, Qel-Droma soon met his brother Cay and Master Jeth during the trek up the mountain, and the group finished the trip together.<ref name="Daudio">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio adaptation]]</ref> During the convocation, venerable spokesman [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] called Qel-Droma and Sunrider up to the stage to speak about their first-hand experiences with the Krath. Although many of the Jedi in the audience wanted to respond to the Krath threat with overwhelming military force, Qel-Droma decided to present a different plan. The Jedi Knight postulated that thousands would die in an all-out war with the Krath, and while order could be restored in the Empress Teta system, the Krath would likely survive and the dark side would continue to spread throughout the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Qel-Droma proposed that one of the Jedi should join the Krath, learn their secrets, and then destroy the conspiracy before it could extend its reach any further. His idea was met with horror and disapproval from the gathered Jedi&mdash; specifically Dace Diath, Shoaneb Culu, and Jeth, who told Qel-Droma that the path of the dark side would inevitably lead to disaster.<ref name="DLotS3" />

Jeth promptly began to address the Jedi assembly on the evils of the dark side but stopped in mid-speech, as he heard a [[Force scream/Legends|scream]] through the Force. Jeth instructed Qel-Droma to listen to the sound, which puzzled the Knight, who compared it to the sound of a man being eaten alive. While the convocation stopped to hear it as well, disaster struck. A Krath fleet arrived in the system and launched a barrage of [[Escape pod/Legends|life-pods]] which contained [[Krath war droid/Legends|war droids]], who [[Battle of Deneba|attacked]] the gathered Jedi. At the same time, [[Service droid/Legends|servant droids]] among the assembly unveiled hidden weapons and began their own assault on the Jedi. Qel-Droma quickly sprang to action, as he drew his lightsaber and battled the droid [[Army/Legends|army]]. Although Qel-Droma was briefly threatened by a [[Knife/Legends|knife]]-wielding droid which slipped behind him and placed him in a chokehold, Jeth advised him on a way to escape, and the droid was destroyed. In the midst of the battle, Qel-Droma thanked Jeth for his help, as he believed that the Jedi Master saved his life. But as Qel-Droma expressed his gratitude, a previously-unseen war droid shot Jeth in the back. Qel-Droma&mdash;who blamed his own inattentiveness for Jeth's wound&mdash;cradled the mortally-injured Jedi Master in his arms as he died and [[Oneness/Legends|passed on]] to the [[Netherworld of the Force/Legends|Netherworld of the Force]]. The Jedi successfully repelled the droid assault, but Qel-Droma could take no joy in the victory, as he grieved over the death of Jeth. Sunrider arrived at his side to comfort him&mdash;Qel-Droma confided that he blamed himself for Jeth's death and vowed to her that he would infiltrate the Krath, destroy it from within, and conquer the dark side.<ref name="DLotS3" /> Qel-Droma also decided to take Jeth's [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robe]], which the Jedi Master had left behind when his mortal body disappeared. Qel-Droma kept the garment as a memento of his teacher for at least one year.<ref name="kotor48">[[Knights of the Old Republic 48|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 48]]</ref>

====Departure====
{{Quote|I'm leaving at dawn, Cay. ''Don't'' try to follow me.''"<br />"''Stang, Ulic&hellip; I&hellip; I'll never see you again. I just ''know'' it.''"<br />"Hey!'' Don't be stupid, kid! Everything will work out ''fine!'' We'll be joking about this ''together'' in a few ''months!''<nowiki></nowiki>|Ulic Qel-Droma and his brother Cay bid each other good-bye|<ref name="DLotS4">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 4]]</ref>}}
[[File:HuggingBrothers.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma hugs his brother Cay before leaving for Empress Teta.]]
With his mind made up, Qel-Droma soon began preparations for his [[Mission to Empress Teta|mission]] to infiltrate the Krath. As he wanted to know everything he could about the people he would soon be forced to deal with, Qel-Droma, with Nomi Sunrider at his side, traveled to the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] on Ossus. There, he met with [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] Jedi Master [[Ood Bnar]], who provided him with a complete history on the Empress Teta system. Qel-Droma expressed his belief that he would be a coward if he passed up an opportunity to battle the dark side, which piqued Bnar's interest. Bnar subsequently brought Qel-Droma to Odan-Urr, who was the [[Library/Legends|Library's]] [[Keeper of Antiquities]]. Odan-Urr produced a rare [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]], and used it to show Qel-Droma the story of a Jedi Knight who similarly tried to conquer the dark side from within, only to be seduced to the dark path and strike down his own master. Stunned by the images he saw, Qel-Droma lashed out at Bnar and Odan-Urr, and proclaimed that they would rather do nothing than try to defeat the dark side. As they realized that he would not be swayed, Bnar and Odan-Urr departed. Qel-Droma went to speak with his brother Cay on the Library's parapets, in what was to be their last meeting before Ulic's departure. Although Cay offered to go with him to Empress Teta, Ulic turned him down and said that he needed to fight the battle alone. Cay was still uncomfortable with the mission, due to his belief that he would never see Ulic again&mdash;however, Ulic waved off his concerns, and the two brothers embraced.<ref name="DLotS4" />

After a night of study, Qel-Droma prepared to depart for Empress Teta on the ''[[Kestrel Nova]]'', a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] recently captured in a battle with [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] near [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]]. By then, his plan was fully formed&mdash;he would disguise himself as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] to enter the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]], then wait for a chance to get close to the Krath. Qel-Droma made the trip to the freighter with Sunrider, who wanted to help Qel-Droma in any way she could. Qel-Droma refused to let her follow him and reiterated what he said to his brother. With that, Qel-Droma and Sunrider parted ways with a goodbye kiss. Qel-Droma was able to make it to Empress Teta, but his arrival in Cinnagar did not go unnoticed, as both Satal and Aleema Keto were able to sense his presence in the city. The next day, Qel-Droma went to the city's central plaza, where the Ketos were holding a public execution for [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] traders who were resisting Krath rule. As Qel-Droma watched the display, one trader, [[Farng]], caught a knife thrown to him from the crowd and leaped at Aleema. Covered by a full-on revolt from allies in the audience, Farng made it to Aleema's platform. Qel-Droma knew that chance to win favor with the Krath had come<ref name="DLotS4" /> and that his plan would be all for naught if the Krath leaders were killed,<ref name="Daudio" /> so he ignited his lightsaber, jumped into the fray, and killed Farng as he attempted to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the dark side magician. Qel-Droma impressed Aleema with his skill and claimed to be a Jedi who had fallen from the way of the light&mdash;little did the Jedi Knight know, the cunning Aleema had planned the whole thing. As Satal Keto continued with the executions, Qel-Droma and Aleema withdrew to the Krath's [[Iron Citadel]]. Despite his actions, Qel-Droma was quickly drugged and incapacitated by his host.<ref name="DLotS4" />

====Path of no return====
{{Quote|&mdash;but I need to know ''more''. I need more time. Tell them not to come looking for me. When I have learned everything I need to know about the dark side&hellip; I will return to Ossus. Please understand I must break the power of Keto and Aleema&hellip; ''they'' are responsible for the death of Master Arca.|Ulic Qel-Droma, in a recorded message to Nomi Sunrider|<ref name="DLotS5">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 5|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 5]]</ref>}}
[[File:SatalQuestionsUlic.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma is questioned by Satal Keto in the Iron Citadel.]]
The [[Sleep/Legends|unconscious]] Qel-Droma was brought to the catacombs below the Iron Citadel, where he was restrained and left at the mercy of a [[Interrogation droid/Legends|torture droid]]. Although Qel-Droma repeatedly pled loyalty to the Krath, the torture droid continued to test Qel-Droma's commitment with electric shocks. Satal and Aleema Keto eventually paid him a visit, and Qel-Droma used the opportunity to assert his claim that he was a fallen Jedi who had come to Cinnagar to learn the ways of the dark side. Unconvinced, Satal Keto injected him with a [[Sith poison]], which Keto claimed would kill Qel-Droma unless he could neutralize its effects with the Force. Qel-Droma, pulled out of his delirium by the [[Poison/Legends|poison]], unleashed a massive outburst of [[Force energy]] that freed him from his bonds but rendered him unconscious. Qel-Droma soon recovered and set about to prove his sincerity to the Krath&mdash;one route he took was to update the obsolete weapons that the Krath had put to use in Cinnagar. During a presentation he gave to the Ketos and other assembled Krath personnel about their outdated defense [[Autoturret/Legends|turrets]], Qel-Droma was informed that another Jedi, a female, had landed in Cinnagar and had been taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]]. Satal Keto, still skeptical of Qel-Droma's intentions, ordered the captured Knight to be brought in&mdash;to Qel-Droma's astonishment, it was Nomi Sunrider, who had come to Empress Teta in an attempt to rescue him. Keto revealed that Sunrider was to be executed the next day, and asked Qel-Droma to carry it out. Conflicted between protecting Sunrider and keeping up his facade, Qel-Droma announced that he would indeed perform the killing, while he privately hoped that Sunrider would find a way to escape.<ref name="DLotS5" />

Although Qel-Droma knew that he could not contact Sunrider through the Force without discovery by Satal Keto, Qel-Droma used a [[G-12 service droid]] to carry a message to the imprisoned Jedi which explained his actions and expressed his need to break the Krath's power. During the act, Qel-Droma was visited by Aleema, who expressed her faith in him. As he realized Aleema's desire for him, Qel-Droma seized the opportunity to use that desire for his own gain, and the two embarked on an affair. Meanwhile, Satal Keto intercepted the servant droid and saw Qel-Droma's [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] message for Sunrider. Angered that Qel-Droma had double-crossed the Krath, Keto sent an assassin, [[Norgor]], to kill the Jedi Knight. Norgor struck just [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] before the appointed time for Sunrider's execution, while Qel-Droma was getting dressed after making love with Aleema Keto and preparing to visit the [[detention area]] to verify that Sunrider had escaped. As Norgor crashed through a nearby [[Window/Legends|window]], [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistols]] blazing, Qel-Droma activated his lightsaber and swiftly struck the assassin down. Meanwhile, Sunrider was able to break free of her captors and make it to the gates of the Iron Citadel, as Cay Qel-Droma and Tott Doneeta rushed to her aid in the ''Nebulon Ranger''. Krath forces were notified of Sunrider's escape and attacked the Jedi as Satal Keto watched from a balcony. Qel-Droma realized what was going on, and made his way to Keto's balcony and called out to his brother, while he proclaimed that Keto was the one who had killed Arca Jeth.<ref name="DLotS5" />

A wave of anger rushed over Qel-Droma, as he drew his lightsaber and [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Satal Keto)|engaged]] the Krath ruler in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]]. While he drowned in hatred, Qel-Droma dealt a mortal blow to Keto. The dying darksider taunted Qel-Droma, and said that his anger had activated the Sith poison injected in him. As Qel-Droma stood over Keto's lifeless body, he lashed out at the other Jedi with a wave of dark side energy that threw them to the ground. Still seething with anger, the once-heroic Jedi Knight swore that he would kill them if they didn't leave him alone, which prompted his brother, Sunrider, and Doneeta to flee in the ''Nebulon Ranger''. As he watched his former brothers-in-arms leave Empress Teta, Qel-Droma realized what Freedon Nadd had told him on Onderon&mdash;that he was on a path of no return.<ref name="DLotS5" />

====Destiny fulfilled====
{{Quote|Let it be so, Qel-Droma&hellip; the ''ancient Sith'' have spoken. ''Together we will bring down the galaxy!"<br />"''Yes. ''Let it be so.''<nowiki></nowiki>|Exar Kun and Ulic Qel-Droma|<ref name="DLotS6">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 6|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 6]]</ref>}}
After the slaying of Satal Keto, Qel-Droma returned to within the Iron Citadel with his new flame, Aleema Keto. While Qel-Droma recuperated from various injuries, Aleema gave him a powerful Sith amulet which had originally belonged to Satal. As he and Keto discussed the Sith artifact and their relationship, they suddenly heard the sounds of a [[Battle of Empress Teta|battle]] in the skies above. A Jedi strike force from Ossus that consisted of four starfighters and a larger transport appeared in the Tetan atmosphere and attacked the Iron Citadel, an act that prompted an aerial clash as the fortress's security team fought back with defensive laser fire. Startled, Qel-Droma looked on as Dace Diath, whom he had fought alongside during the Naddist revolt, destroyed Krath turrets just outside his window. In the midst of the chaos, the transport dropped several Onderonian warbeasts that broke into Qel-Droma's room&mdash;on their backs rode Nomi Sunrider, Cay, and another fellow Onderon veteran, Qrrrl Toq. As Toq and Cay went off to deal with the guards, Sunrider tried to convince Qel-Droma to leave Empress Teta with her, as she fended off Keto's dark illusions all the while. However, Qel-Droma refused to go with her and the other Jedi. Although Cay stepped in and pleaded with Ulic to reconsider, Ulic coldly shoved him away. Ulic asserted that he was not under the influence of the dark side, and would continue his mission in the name of Arca Jeth. His mind made up, Qel-Droma told his brother and Sunrider to leave him alone once and for all.<ref name="DLotS6" />

[[File:UlicExarUnited.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma and Exar Kun join forces.]]
Undaunted, Cay and Sunrider continued their pleas. Ulic became filled with rage, and used the power of the Sith amulet to lash out at the Jedi. The scene became a mad scramble, as Toq tried to grab hold of the talisman while Cay attempted to restrain Ulic. Cay and Toq used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|hold Ulic back]], but as they moved to strap him to the back of a warbeast, Sunrider ordered them to stop. Sunrider told the Jedi to leave Ulic in the Iron Citadel, as they had been told by the Jedi Masters that he would come with them on his own accord or not at all. Qel-Droma freed himself, and returned to Keto as the Jedi begrudgingly left him behind. As he watched Sunrider depart on her warbeast, Qel-Droma assured her that he would indeed finish his work on Empress Teta.<ref name="DLotS6" />

[[File:Ulic_Qel-Droma.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma before confronting Exar Kun.]]
Qel-Droma did not have any time to rest, however, as another Jedi appeared in the room. His name was [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]&mdash;Qel-Droma recognized him as a so-called Sith pretender mentioned to Keto by the spirit of Freedon Nadd. Although Keto attacked him with Sith magic, Kun easily defeated her. Qel-Droma drew his lightsaber and [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Exar Kun)|dueled]] Kun, but an unexpected development interrupted their showdown. Kun possessed a Sith amulet similar to the one Qel-Droma had, and as they battled, the two artifacts began to glow, and their auras enveloped the two combatants. The glows combined to form the image of a Dark Lord dead centuries ago, [[Marka Ragnos]]. The ghostly image of Ragnos told the duelers to stop, while Qel-Droma and Kun looked on in shock. Ragnos proclaimed that their dark initiation was to be completed, and dubbed Kun the new Dark Lord of the Sith. Qel-Droma was also deemed a Sith, as Kun's new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]. With a touch of the dead Dark Lord's hand, a distinctive<ref name="DLotS6" /> [[Mark of Shadow Hand|Sith mark]] of a [[Shadow Hand]]<ref name="kotorcg">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> was placed on Qel-Droma's forehead. Ragnos told the new Sith that they would take their revenge on the Republic before disappearing. Now transformed, Qel-Droma and Kun clasped hands and resolved to bring down the galaxy.<ref name="DLotS6" />

===The Sith War===
====Duel with the Mandalore====
{{Quote|A glorious combat, Ulic Qel-Droma. I cede. My warriors are yours. Kill me.''"<br />"''I am not interested in your death, Mandalore. I have a much better fate for you. A ''much'' better fate.|Mandalore the Indomitable and Ulic Qel-Droma, after their duel|<ref name="TSW1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 1]]</ref>}}
Over the next six months, the newly minted [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Qel-Droma and Kun prepared to bring about a new [[Golden Age of the Sith]].<ref name="TSW1" /> During what would be dubbed the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], Kun created the [[Dark Reaper]], a large, saucer-shaped [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] that fired massive bolts of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and was nearly impossible to defeat.<ref name="Reaper">{{CSWECite|I|184|Dark Reaper}}</ref> To power the gigantic vehicle, the Sith created the [[Force Harvester]], which would drain the Force from every living organism that came into close proximity with the Harvester, and built it into the center of the Dark Reaper.<ref name="Clone Wars">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref> Key to Kun's plans for the destruction of the Republic one planet at a time, the Dark Reaper killed thousands during the war<ref name="Reaper" />&mdash;in one [[Battle of Raxus Prime (Great Sith War)|battle]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], Qel-Droma used it to kill hundreds of Republic soldiers.<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> During his service with the Sith, Qel-Droma learned how to counter the effects of the Force Harvester for a short time, which allowed him to approach the superweapon without harm. He also learned how to defeat the Dark Reaper through the destruction of its many weapon emplacements and then with the deactivation of the Force Harvester.<ref name="Clone Wars" /> As the conflict continued, Qel-Droma and Kun realized that they did not have a large enough army to win a head-to-head war with the Republic. The task fell upon Qel-Droma to gather such an [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|army]], while Kun set about to lure more dark side disciples.<ref name="TSW1" />

[[File:Battle_of_Kuar.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma duels with the Mandalore.]]
A suitable army fell right into Qel-Droma's lap in [[3996 BBY]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior clans, led by their [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|chief]] [[Mandalore the Indomitable]], arrived in the Empress Teta system&mdash;as he believed that the system was in chaos, the Mandalore intended to conquer the area. Qel-Droma's defense forces were taken completely by surprise, as the Mandalorians' [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]] destroyed an important [[Tetan carbonite smelter]]. As he commanded his forces from a [[Supremacy-class attack ship|Krath yacht]], Qel-Droma, in a bold move, contacted the Mandalore and ordered the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] to surrender. Although the Mandalore refused to capitulate, he countered with an offer to Qel-Droma&mdash;a [[Duel on Kuar|duel]] to the death on the [[Plains of Harkul]] of the planet [[Kuar]], and if Qel-Droma won, the Mandalorians would serve him. Qel-Droma accepted, and even allowed the Mandalore to name the terms of the fight once they reached Harkul. As such, Mandalore the Indomitable wrote the rules to greatly favor himself, as he did not permit Qel-Droma a mount or to stand on solid ground, while he was able to use his personal Basilisk war droid.<ref name="TSW1" />

In front of a large audience that consisted mostly of warriors from both the Krath and Mandalorian armies, the duel began. Although Qel-Droma was severely disadvantaged, he was able to evade the Mandalore's laser fire, and destroyed the warlord's Basilisk with a stroke of his lightsaber. After that exchange, Qel-Droma and the Mandalore found themselves standing across from each other on a large chain. Mandalore the Indomitable told Qel-Droma to put away his lightsaber, and fight him with the traditional [[Mythosaur axe/Legends|bladed weapon]] of Mandalorians past. Qel-Droma boldly claimed that he could defeat the Mandalore with any weapon, and briefly let his guard down as he turned off his lightsaber. Mandalore the Indomitable took the opportunity to swing his weapon at the Sith Lord&mdash;although Qel-Droma was able to dodge the attack, he lost his balance and fell from his tenuous foothold. Qel-Droma landed on a Mandalorian spectator's Basilisk, however, knocked the onlooker off his mount, and took his blade. Qel-Droma commandeered the Basilisk droid and flew toward the Mandalore at full speed; with one slash of his weapon, he drove the Mandalore off his perch and to a hard landing on the ground below. The injured Mandalore conceded the victory to Qel-Droma and asked him to give him an honorable death on the battlefield. However, Qel-Droma refused to take his life, and instead made the warlord his [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] as he seized control of the Mandalorian forces.<ref name="TSW1" />

====Striking at the heart====
{{Quote|I don't come in the name of the Jedi&hellip; I come in the name of the future, a new golden age for the galaxy&hellip; a future based on the Sith, not the creaking old Republic.|Ulic Qel-Droma, during the Battle of Coruscant|<ref name="TSW2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 2]]</ref>}}
Now with a sizable Mandalorian army, Qel-Droma raided several Republic [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] and supply bases.<ref name="TSW3">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 3]]</ref> Eventually, he turned his attention to the Republic [[Foerost Shipyards|shipyards]] at [[Foerost/Legends|Foerost]], where the Republic supplied their [[Republic Navy/Legends|navies]] with advanced [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. Qel-Droma gathered a force of attack ships to [[Battle of Foerost (Great Sith War)|strike]] at Foerost, and used Aleema Keto's Sith illusions to conceal his approach. His combined Krath and Mandalorian forces utterly destroyed the Republic military presence at Foerost, as they worked together for an easy victory. After victory became assured, Qel-Droma personally visited the shipyards' command center. In front of a terrified band of shipyard employees, Qel-Droma demanded the operations codes for all the newly completed warships, and even killed [[Unidentified Foerost shipyards employee|one employee]] when he refused to cooperate. After he intimidated the workmen into giving him the codes, Qel-Droma was in charge of three hundred of the galaxy's newest warships. Qel-Droma promptly received a message from Exar Kun, who told his apprentice to continue to gather more ships. Instead, Qel-Droma announced his intention to strike at the Republic capital, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]&mdash;as the Republic would expect more raids on shipyards and military outposts, Qel-Droma reasoned, an attack on the government's heart would be the correct move. Although Kun did not agree with Qel-Droma's plan, he knew that his apprentice would not be swayed, and he begrudgingly allowed Qel-Droma to attack Coruscant.<ref name="TSW1" />

[[File:QelDromaAdvance-TSW2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma leads an assault on the Republic war room on Coruscant.]]
Before departing from Foerost, Qel-Droma took the time to leave a diversion to cover his assault on Coruscant. He planted a security recording that showed him discussing [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Kemplex Nine]] as his next target; Orley Vanicus, dispatched to investigate the attack on Foerost, happened upon Qel-Droma's message and fell for the trap. Vanicus ordered the main Republic fleet to guard Kemplex Nine, while Coruscant was left without vital defenses. Qel-Droma took this opportunity to [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Sith War)|attack]] Coruscant, backed by a large strike force of Mandalorians and Krath [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. Republic Minister of Defense Netus rallied a group of remaining Republic soldiers to defend the world, led by a group of Jedi including Cay Qel-Droma and Nomi Sunrider. Ulic's battle plan was primarily to occupy the Republic [[Republic command center|war room]] and crush their central military command. Qel-Droma initially stayed out of the brunt of the fighting, as he instead watched the advance teams wreak havoc on Coruscant alongside Aleema Keto and the Mandalore. At the Mandalore's behest, Qel-Droma sent a phalanx of Mandalorian troops to seize the Republic's new weapons manufactured near the war room. Meanwhile, backed by a team of Krath soldiers and Keto's Sith illusions, Qel-Droma joined the battle himself and pushed toward his enemy's command center. Qel-Droma and his allies utterly destroyed the Republic troops defending the war room and entered the structure itself.<ref name="TSW2" />

Upon entrance into the war room, Qel-Droma found a surviving [[Unidentified Republic official|Republic official]]. Qel-Droma used the Force to control the man's mind and ordered him to tell each Republic [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] to deploy their [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] to a single point in the [[Vento system/Legends|Vento system]], where they would all collide and destroy each other. Suddenly, however, Qel-Droma's forces retreated and left him and his personal guardsmen alone in the command center; unbeknownst to the Sith Lord, Aleema Keto had betrayed him and ordered the Mandalorians and Tetans to pull back, an act that abandoned him to approaching Jedi. Before Qel-Droma could achieve his goal of destroying the Republic [[Navy/Legends|Navy]], a team of several Jedi, led by Cay and Nomi Sunrider, broke into the war room. Qel-Droma drew his lightsaber and readied himself for a fight, but the [[Krevaaki]] Jedi Master [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]], Kun's former teacher, immobilized him with a [[Wall of light|Jedi power]]. The Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Sidrona]], who was present, declared Qel-Droma under the jurisdiction of the Galactic Republic, and proclaimed that the Sith Lord would face trial and a death sentence.<ref name="TSW2" />

====Schemes====
{{Quote|I don't plead with fools. You are puppets of tradition pretending to be important. The coming golden age has no place for you. Your Republic is an empty, self-indulgent delusion&hellip; signifying ''nothing''. The lost glory of the Sith will turn all of your supposed accomplishments to dust!|Ulic Qel-Droma addresses the Senate|<ref name="TSW3" />}}
[[File:WaitingForSentencing.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma awaits his trial.]]
Qel-Droma's [[Trial of Ulic Qel-Droma|trial]] was to be held in front of the entire [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]&mdash;accordingly, Qel-Droma was kept in a small, dark cell within the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate Rotunda]] itself. As the trial began, he was led out of his [[Prison/Legends|prison]] by several guards and faced an audience consisting of hundreds of [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] and Jedi, including his brother and Nomi Sunrider. The legal proceeding was presided by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] himself, who charged Qel-Droma with dozens of crimes including destructions of shipyards, raids on supply bases, and enslavement of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], but most seriously, breaking his oath of allegiance to the Republic. Still, Qel-Droma refused to repent for his actions and denounced the Chancellor as an ineffectual puppet. As the audience looked on in stunned silence, Qel-Droma proclaimed that the end of the Republic and the new Sith Golden Age were at hand. Mortified by his brother's actions, Cay stormed the Senate floor and pleaded for the Supreme Chancellor to remember Ulic's good deeds as a Jedi, and reasoned that Ulic was greatly disturbed and led astray by Master Jeth's death. As the Senate floor began to erupt in chaos, Ulic broke free of his [[Binders/Legends|restraints]]. At that point, Exar Kun, accompanied by the Mandalore and a massive force of Sith [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors, burst into the Senate Rotunda. As Kun attacked and killed the Supreme Chancellor, the freed Qel-Droma dared his brother and Sunrider to attack him&mdash;however, they could not bring themselves to do so.<ref name="TSW3" />

As the Sith and the Jedi faced off, their attention was drawn to Vodo-Siosk Baas, who quietly entered the [[Senate Hall]] and confronted his former pupil, Kun. Qel-Droma and the entire Senate, who had been placed under a Sith spell, looked on as Kun offered Baas a place in his [[Brotherhood of the Sith|Sith Order]]. When Baas refused, Kun drew his lightsaber and initiated a [[Duel in the Senate|duel]]. In the end, Baas was slain, and Qel-Droma left the Senate with his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]].<ref name="TSW3" /> The two went to Kun's [[Great Temple/Legends|stronghold]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], where Qel-Droma met with Mandalore the Indomitable to discuss the recent events. There, the Mandalore revealed that Aleema Keto had betrayed him. Infuriated, Qel-Droma resolved to deal with her, but did not let on his intentions during an encounter with her soon after. With the upper hand in the Great Sith War, the Sith planned their next strike, and Qel-Droma saw a way to put his plot to eliminate Keto into action. Qel-Droma informed Keto that she would lead the next attack&mdash;later, it was resolved that she would do so alongside the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] Dark Jedi [[Crado]], who had recently returned from a failed attempt to kill Master [[Thon]], Nomi Sunrider's former teacher. Qel-Droma decided that they would [[Battle of Kemplex Nine|strike]] at Kemplex Nine, an important way-station where they could lure much of the Republic fleet to its doom. Qel-Droma and Kun, aware and approving of his apprentice's plot, gave Keto and Crado command of the [[Corsair (Derriphan-class)|''Corsair'']], an ancient warship with massive Sith power.<ref name="TSW4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 4]]</ref>

Although the ''Corsair'' was exceptionally powerful, Qel-Droma and Kun had no qualms giving control of it to the traitorous Keto, as its Sith power would backfire on her if all went according to plan. After she lured a squadron of Jedi starships to Kemplex Nine with an attack on the station, Keto utilized the ''Corsair''{{'s}} magnifying power to tear out the core of one of the [[Star/Legends|stars]] in the nearby [[Cron Cluster/Legends|Cron Cluster]], and, wielding the radioactive core as a projectile weapon, wiped out the Jedi. However, as planned, the loss of the star's core caused a chain reaction that resulted in the entire Cron [[Star cluster/Legends|Cluster]] going nova. The [[Cron Supernova/Legends|Cron Supernova]] destroyed Keto and the ''Corsair'', which finally rid Qel-Droma of his nuisance. In addition, the shockwave, which was heading directly toward the Great Jedi Library on Ossus, would surely cause the Jedi to evacuate the world. The Sith Lords knew that this would happen, and Qel-Droma and Kun promptly prepared to head for Ossus to steal the [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi treasures]] located in the Library.<ref name="TSW4" />

====Endgame====
{{Quote|I know where to find him. I can take you there&hellip; ''to Yavin Four!''<nowiki></nowiki>|Ulic Qel-Droma, stripped of the Force|<ref name="TSW6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref>}}
[[File:Duel_on_Ossus_Great_Sith_War.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma killing his brother on Ossus]]
As a desperate evacuation commenced on Ossus, Qel-Droma and Kun descended upon the planet. Although the Mandalore and most of the Mandalorian warriors were in [[Battle of Onderon (Great Sith War)|battle]] on Onderon, Qel-Droma carried a sizable group of Mandalorians along with him, while a Massassi force traveled with Kun. As soon as they entered Ossus's atmosphere, Qel-Droma launched the Mandalorians to create a [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|diversion]] while the two Sith flew closer to the Library. However, Cay Qel-Droma, who was planetside assisting in the evacuation, sensed Ulic's presence through the Force and went up to meet him in the ''Nebulon Ranger''. Although Cay, who joyously thought that Ulic had returned to the light, contacted his brother, Ulic&mdash;who was flying his own [[Cay's Dream|starship]]&mdash;told Cay to leave him alone. Cay still refused to go away and pursued Ulic through the Ossus skies, and targeted laser strikes on Ulic's [[Engine/Legends|engines]] as they both dodged airborne Mandalorian warmounts. However, Ulic was able to maneuver his ship behind the ''Nebulon Ranger'', and shot his brother down. The ''Nebulon Ranger'' crashed, but Cay survived; meanwhile, Ulic landed safely nearby. As his wounded brother staggered out of the wreckage of ''Nebulon Ranger'', Ulic, bleeding from an old Sith wound, ignited his lightsaber. Cay responded in turn, albeit reluctantly, and the two brothers dueled. Their battle brought them through the Ossus streets, and Ulic severed Cay's mechanical arm with a stroke of his lightsaber. Helpless, Cay tried to reason with his opponent, but Ulic would have none of it. Overcome by rage, Ulic raised his lightsaber and struck his brother down.<ref name="TSW5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 5]]</ref>

[[File:StrippedUlic.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma is stripped of the Force.]]
As Cay's life faded away, Ulic was overcome by remorse and sorrow.<ref name="TSW5" /> Ulic held his brother's corpse and wept&mdash;Nomi Sunrider and Tott Doneeta arrived on the scene almost immediately. Sunrider was shocked and horrified, and although Ulic begged for mercy, she [[Sever Force/Legends|stripped]] him of his connection through the Force by imprisoning him in a wall of light. Although Sunrider immediately regretted her action, Ulic Qel-Droma was left to deal with the fact that he was no longer a Jedi. Master Thon and Oss Wilum joined the party soon afterward, and though they understood Qel-Droma's guilt and grief, they prevailed upon him to help them stop Kun, who had absconded with a number of Jedi treasures. As he knew that Kun had returned to Yavin 4, Qel-Droma composed himself and offered to bring them to the moon. Qel-Droma and Doneeta carried Cay's body aboard Qel-Droma's ship, and alongside Sunrider and her daughter [[Vima Sunrider|Vima]], they traveled to Yavin 4 alongside a massive Jedi fleet. The Jedi force, thousands of ships strong, soon [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Great Sith War)|arrived]] at Yavin 4. Qel-Droma was the first to make contact with his former Sith Master, and declared that the Jedi were united against the dark side. As the gathered Jedi created a wall of light to engulf the moon, the jungle below suddenly erupted into a fiery inferno. The size of the conflagration was such that nothing living below could survive. Confident that Kun was defeated, the broken Qel-Droma left Yavin 4 with the other Jedi.<ref name="TSW6" />

After his return to the side of the Jedi, Qel-Droma realized the danger that the Dark Reaper posed to the galaxy and taught the Jedi the secret of how to bring down the superweapon. Qel-Droma led a group of Jedi to the planet [[Thule/Legends|Thule]], where they were able to successfully [[Battle of Thule (Great Sith War)|disable]] the Reaper. Following the battle, the Jedi detached the Force Harvester from the Reaper and hid the Harvester on the backwater world of Raxus Prime. The Jedi also buried the Reaper under the Thule city of [[Kesiak]].<ref name="Clone Wars" /> Over the next two years, Qel-Droma wandered across the galaxy on an unfruitful quest to discover a way for him to become a Jedi again. In [[3994 BBY]], after a pilgrimage to his brother's [[Qel-Droma's Grave|gravesite]] in his newly renamed ship, ''Cay's Dream'', Qel-Droma returned to the scorched moon of Yavin 4 determined to find out just what had happened on that fateful day. Qel-Droma journeyed across the destroyed forest, and eventually came to the Great Temple where Exar Kun had made his headquarters. However, still blind and deaf to the Force, Qel-Droma could feel nothing there, and left.<ref name="TSW6" />

===Redemption===
====Self-exile====
{{Quote|I am alone. This place is so quiet, empty&hellip; but still I have no peace. The Force has abandoned me&hellip; I can feel nothing.|Ulic Qel-Droma|<ref name="redemption2">[[Tales of the Jedi – Redemption 2|''Tales of the Jedi – Redemption'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:TOTJRedemption-FC.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Ulic Qel-Droma on Rhen Var]]
For the next eight years, Qel-Droma continued to wander the galaxy as he tried to hide from his past. Although guilty of war crimes during his period as a Sith Lord, Qel-Droma was never prosecuted for them and was left to his own devices. At some point over this time, Qel-Droma scratched out the Sith mark on his forehead. In [[3986 BBY]], Qel-Droma decided to isolate himself permanently from the galaxy and hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] named [[Hoggon]] to take him to a place where he could live as a hermit for the rest of his days. With no knowledge of Qel-Droma's identity or connection to the moon, Hoggon first brought the former Jedi to Yavin 4, which had finally regained its green jungles. Hoggon landed the ship and showed Qel-Droma the great [[Sith temple/Legends|temples]] of Exar Kun, and informed his customer of the final battle of the Great Sith War over Yavin 4 and Ulic Qel-Droma's betrayal of the Dark Lord. As Qel-Droma walked through the Sith ruins, he saw a vision of that battle, including one of his dead brother Cay. Abruptly, he turned and told the diminutive Hoggon that Yavin 4 would not do as a hideaway. Instead, Hoggon took Qel-Droma to the [[Water/Legends|icy]] world of [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]]. Still emerging from a recent ice age, Rhen Var was essentially uninhabited, although some artificial structures were still intact. Qel-Droma and Hoggon traveled to a large [[Ulic Qel-Droma's citadel|citadel]], almost covered in snow, that still stood in the harsh Rhen Var landscape. Qel-Droma approved of the structure as suitable and sent the spacer on his way.<ref name="redemption1">[[Tales of the Jedi – Redemption 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Redemption'' 1]]</ref>

Although Qel-Droma, who had taken up residence on Rhen Var, was finally alone, he still could not find peace. He spent time practicing with his still-operational lightsaber, though he lamented the fact that he was still cut off from the Force and that his blade was now no more than a tool. As he took a walk in the snowy landscape beyond his new home, the ground underneath Qel-Droma's feet gave way, and he fell into a deep chasm. Qel-Droma was trapped there for some time. During his time in that pit, he reflected on his past, and deeply regretted his betrayal of his lover Nomi Sunrider and the death of his brother Cay. While he wallowed in grief, Qel-Droma wondered why he could not just die there on the spot, and be rid of his grief&mdash;at that point, the Force spirit of his Jedi Master, the long-dead Arca Jeth, appeared to Qel-Droma. Jeth told his former charge that he should not give up on life and that, although Qel-Droma may lack power in the Force, he still had his inner strength. Inspired and grateful, Qel-Droma summoned the power to dig his way out of the hole, and promised his Master that he would indeed live on; for what purpose, he did not know.<ref name="redemption2" />

====A newfound apprentice====
{{Quote|Nomi doesn't know you're here, does she?''"<br />"''My mother doesn't notice whether I'm there or not. She doesn't know how badly I want to be a Jedi.''"<br />"''Do you realize the cost of being a Jedi? I have watched my Master slain, murdered my own brother, betrayed your mother&hellip; all of this, only to become blinded to the Force. I no longer enjoy my memories, Vima. I have wandered too far, seen too much&hellip; I have the blood of enough children on my hands&hellip; why would you want anything I can teach you?''"<br />"''Because you're&hellip; Ulic.|Ulic Qel-Droma and Vima Sunrider|<ref name="redemption3">[[Tales of the Jedi – Redemption 3|''Tales of the Jedi – Redemption'' 3]]</ref>}}
[[File:UlicMeetsVima.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Ulic Qel-Droma meets Vima Sunrider for the first time in years.]]
On one of his first few days on Rhen Var, Qel-Droma was in the corridors of his fortress when, through a broken window, he saw a red-haired girl whom he briefly thought was Nomi Sunrider.
